name: viteTranslate
description: Keyless i18n for React + Vite: write the sentence in JSX, values and tags included. The plugin extracts it inside Vite, keeps the YAML locales in sync, compiles ICU at build time and ships one lazy chunk per language — 5 kB gzip runtime, zero runtime dependencies. LLM translation and a VS Code panel built in.

paragraphs: Write text naturally in JSX. viteTranslate extracts strings, keeps locale files in sync, and compiles translations as part of your Vite workflow. No hand-written keys. No separate extraction workflow. No extra runtime dependencies.

✅ native support · 🟡 partial support, official add-on or extra setup · ❌ not offered by the project. Documentation checked on October 10, 2026: Lingui 6, FormatJS (react-intl 12), i18next 26 + react-i18next 17.
🡷 Notes on the comparison, and what each feature buys you
